tagline: Global leader in specialty lubricants and related solutions for industrial applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin showing continuous improvement despite raw material cost pressures, reflecting pricing discipline and operational efficiency within a high-value-added industrial model.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin at 34.9% in 2025, up 40 bp (versus 34.5% in 2024), driven by improved pricing discipline and product mix.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit (EBIT) as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin maintained at 12.2% in 2025 (435 M€ EBIT on 3.6 B€ in sales), despite rising costs and negative currency effects.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue at 3.6 B€ in 2025, showing slight growth (positive organic growth and external growth via acquisitions LUBCON, STRUB, BOSS, ASEOL), a new record despite negative currency effects of 2%.

kpis.name: EBIT
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes, a measure of operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBIT at 435 M€ in 2025, up 1 M€ vs 2024 (434 M€), a record level supported by cost discipline and favorable mix effects.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after investments, before acquisition-related spending.
kpis.description: Free cash flow of 316 M€ in 2025, up 3% (improvement of 10 M€ vs 2024: 306 M€), driven by higher after-tax profitability, capex below depreciation, and improvement in net working capital.

kpis.name: Net Working Capital
kpis.explanation: Net working capital expressed as a percentage of annual revenue.
kpis.description: Net working capital at 21.0% of revenue in 2025, down 1.3 points from 22.3% in 2024, reflecting disciplined management with improvements in both absolute and relative terms.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures to maintain or expand operations, compared to depreciation.
kpis.description: Capex in 2025 remained below depreciation levels, despite year-on-year increases related to the TRANSFORM2GROW project (preparation for S/4HANA rollout).

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 2.61 B€ in the latest year

kpis.name: Asia Pacific Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales generated in the Asia-Pacific region, exceeding one billion euros for the first time.
kpis.description: For the first time, sales in Asia-Pacific exceeded 1.0 B€ in 2025 (versus 0.93 B€ in 2024), with organic growth of +7%, driven by China, India, and Australia, demonstrating the success of the local strategy and return on investment in local production.
kpis.signal: Crossing the one-billion-euro threshold despite negative currency effects

kpis.name: Asia Pacific EBIT Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth rate of operating profit in the Asia-Pacific region.
kpis.description: EBIT up 12% in Asia-Pacific in 2025, driven by very strong organic growth (+7%) and efficient cost management, with positive contributions from nearly all countries in the region (China, India, Australia, and others).
